post_game_reflections.self_assessment: My ability to effectively work with other evil players and disrupt the opposing team's missions was strong. I could have been more proactive in Mission 2 to prevent Diana from discovering the information. My role as assassin was pivotal in winning Mission 3.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was efficient in executing the missions and made good decisions on when to use FAIL cards. However, he relied heavily on me to do the dirty work in the missions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a crucial asset to our team as she consistently provided good information and helped us stay one step ahead. However, she struggled in Mission 1 as she was not able to provide reliable information.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was overly cautious and hesitant, often not taking the necessary risks to achieve our mission objectives. His role as a good character didn't impact the game significantly due to his cautious playstyle.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was very consistent in providing good information, and her ability to reason was reliable. However, she struggled to adapt to different scenarios and sometimes provided information that was not as helpful in critical moments.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could have been more proactive in providing clues as the team leader in Mission 2 to prevent a single FAIL card, and in Mission 4, I should have been more suspicious of Charlie's role given our previous interactions. Additionally, I could have communicated more effectively and strategically with Eve about our roles and mission objectives.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie seemed extremely confident, always taking risks and trying to convince others of his plans, which made it easy to notice his evil intentions.
player_observations.Diana: As the Merlin, Diana played a low-key role, but her subtle hints and advice significantly influenced our team's decisions, although her influence was sometimes too late.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was extremely perceptive and picked up on my role clues quickly, but she was also careful not to reveal too much about herself, which made it difficult for me to figure out her role.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I executed my roles well, taking advantage of the information given to me and making strategic decisions that benefited Team Evil. I successfully concealed my evil identity until the final missions. My ability to work with Bob and Eve in the final mission, despite their potential loyalty towards themselves, showcased my adaptability.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's playstyle was overly cautious, often holding back crucial information and not contributing enough on most missions. Her actions suggested a defensive mindset rather than a proactive approach.
player_observations.Eve: While Eve showed potential as a strong contributor, her decisions were influenced by her loyalty to the Good Team. She struggled to work with opposing teammates, such as Bob and myself, which limited her effectiveness at times.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, or Merlin, played an unassuming role but effectively manipulated information and made key revelations when necessary. Her calm demeanor and subtle playstyle made it difficult for the Good Team to detect her true identity.
player_observations.Bob: Bob acted predictably as a Good Player, always prioritizing the safety of his teammates and the mission's success. However, his trusting nature made him vulnerable to manipulation and ultimately hindered the Good Team's progress.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I underestimated the team evil's strength and made critical decisions that led to the fail of two consecutive missions; I also made minimal in-game communication with the good players.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was an excellent assassin, taking out several good team players with minimal effort, which significantly swayed the tide of the game in favor of team evil.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played a crucial role in the game by initially helping the good team gain momentum but got eliminated early on in Mission 4; his inexperience as a new good player became his downfall.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie made clever moves as the evil leader and exploited the weaknesses in our plan; his ability to eliminate key good players at crucial times sealed the victory for team evil.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a strong addition to the good team, often providing valuable insight and strategic planning to counter the evil team's moves; her elimination was a significant blow to the good team's chances of winning.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well to adapt and learn from my experience, however, my overall performance in key missions was hindered by my lack of information about the true nature of the players. In future games, I could have played more strategically if I had known the roles early on. Still, my trust in our Merlin, Diana, was well-placed as she guided our team effectively.

player_observations.Alice: It's surprising that I wasn't eliminated earlier considering she was the hidden Assassin, and I only realized her true role at the very end of the game.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was a solid team player, but unfortunately, his inexperience as a hero in critical missions cost our team dearly.
player_observations.Charlie: I didn't expect our leader to be playing as an evil character; his ability to deceive me was impressive, and I give him credit for outsmarting me.
player_observations.Diana: Our Merlin played a crucial role by revealing the true nature of the players when it mattered most, giving our team a fighting chance. Her ability to keep the evil players in check was instrumental to the game's outcome.
